protocol.measurementClock: deterministic clock advancing 1 ms per read (production condition, reproducible)
protocol.equivalenceClock: frozen at 2026-11-03T00:00:00.000Z with a deterministic UUID sequence; durable output must be byte-identical
protocol.order: each round alternates which side runs first
protocol.sides: baseline restores lib/domain-storage.js and lib/event-log-checkpoint.js from the recorded revision into a copy of lib/; candidate is this working tree
protocol.warmup: the seeded history is absorbed by a cold pass, then `warmup` flushed bursts
protocol.instrumentedPass: one additional pass per side with wrapped fs/crypto calls; counts are per flush
protocol.historyShape: the seeded history is a committed applied marker table plus its signed log; the aggregate starts empty, because this round touches neither the aggregate nor its projection
